finalModelMessage:
Could not complete registration. No confirmation code.

What stopped me:

1. On `/inaccessible`, the session list’s **Register** controls are not exposed as buttons or links (they appear only as unlabeled images plus mixed text). Role-based click on `link`/`button` named “Register” timed out. I opened `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms` directly instead.

2. I set **Full name** to “Jordan Lee” and **Email** to “jordan-not-an-email”, then clicked **Complete registration**. The accessibility tree did not show any validation error; the form stayed as-is.

3. **Meal preference** is only static text (“Meal preference…”), not a labeled combobox/select, so `selectOption`/`click` on it failed.

4. The terms **checkbox** has no accessible name, so it could not be checked via the provided tools.

5. Tool budget ran out while correcting the email to `jordan.lee@example.com`, before a successful final submit.
